decisions.structure: CSharp EmitBoxExpression evaluates and materializes the payload, copies fixed storage when required and obtains its pointer through EmitHeapAllocate, which rejects null before a store. Native common emitBoxIntrinsic retains type/layout/copy decisions but directly stores through the unchecked allocation pointer. Existing Native emitAllocationGuard implements the matching source-owned allocation_failed decision.
decisions.branches: Normal original48 and primitive/nested/readonly boxes, fixed-copy admission, entry and while consumers, original78 Result branch payloads; deterministic original48 allocation returning null before payload initialization. CSharp7 normal plus1 null-failure passed first.
decisions.logic: Connect the existing common allocation guard immediately after the box allocator call and before the payload store. Preserve allocation byte count, alignment, fixed-storage copy and move/remove decisions. Use the function owner passed to emitBoxIntrinsic for the existing common source diagnostic. Do not replace the raw platform allocator, weaken failure status or change original fixtures/expected values.
decisions.diagnostics: Actual CSharp injected null exits with llvm.trap (-1073741795) and exact .Point.boxed:allocation_failed before writing the payload. Current Native source lacks that comparison/branch. Native failure must match the same diagnostic and trap before payload store; checker mutation controls reject missing/inverted guards or wrong owner. No full Native baseline rebuild is needed to locate the missing source call.
